query:
SELECT 
  SUM(COALESCE(cat1,0)) as avulso_clube,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat2,0)) as servico_extra,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat3,0)) as auxiliar,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat4,0)) as keune,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat5,0)) as don_alcides,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat6,0)) as caixinha,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat7,0)) as barbiero,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat8,0)) as bar,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat9,0)) as recorrencia,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat1,0)+COALESCE(cat2,0)+COALESCE(cat3,0)+COALESCE(cat4,0)+COALESCE(cat5,0)+COALESCE(cat6,0)+COALESCE(cat7,0)+COALESCE(cat8,0)+COALESCE(cat9,0)) as total_geral
FROM faturamentos
WHERE empresaSlug = 'MASCOTE'
  AND data LIKE '2026-03-%';
